notes.title: NEW UPDATE v0.83 AVAILABLE!!!

notes.title: NEW UPDATE v0.82 IS HERE!!!
notes.content:
Hi Hunters!

As I said, I am working hard to trying to release one update per month (more or less)

This new version comes with some interesting features to improve the future balancing of the game. Now the game includes a connection to a backend in order to get always the latest versions of the game data avoiding do a lot of steam updates only for balance.

Also, new environments have been added to improve the progression feeling and avoid repetitive backgrounds during long time periods.

UPDATE CONTENT:

[list]
[*] From this version (0.82) an internet connection is recommended in order to synchronize game files at startup. If the internet is not available, you will continue playing with your latest downloaded local files.
[*] Added a coupon/code system in the Main Menu, where you can redeem them and get rewards as resources, new armors, and more..., the codes will be available through RRSS, streams, events, ...
[*] Added new environment VILLAGE before FOREST
[*] Added new environment MOUNTAINS between FOREST and SWAMPS
[*] Small UI fixes and improvements
[/list]

I hope you enjoy it!

I am working in the next update!!

notes.title: NEW UPDATE v.08 Available !!
notes.content:
Hi Hunters,

As you know, and I said in my previous announcement, it´s being a really hard time for me between personal and works stuff, going slowly in the Deck Hunter development, and for that reason, I am not updating the game with the speed that I would like.

But finally, a new update is available with important changes in Forge and armors.

[b]CHANGELOG v.08[/b]

** BIG CHANGE IN FORGE SECTION ***

Due the feedback received from the community about problems with the balancing on several  armors in the Forge, and evaluating the amount of work for balance each new piece of armor in future, from now, the armors will have only an aesthetic function in the game, but each time that you forge a new piece, you will receive a card of your current level as reward. 

At the same time, the Forge has been COMPLETELY RE-DONE from scratch, making it much better visually and in terms of funcionality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33284541/abe80a3292ac422f464496254892ce1c94147a04.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33284541/a6a8c97fcc57c09fb6eb758cdd9dc68d7d09e6d2.png[/img]

UPDATE CONTENT:

[list]
[*] [NEW] Forge completely redesigned.
[*] [NEW] Forge has been added to Main Menu too, in order you can set your armor without entering the map.
[*] [NEW] Armors pieces now have only aesthetic function.
[*] [NEW] Each time you forge a new piece you will receive a card of your current level (you can skip or pick it)
[*] [NEW] Added new armor SCORPION in two variants (SILVER and BLACK/GOLD)
[*] [NEW] Added 4 new Achievements to unlock


[*] [CHANGE] Cards in libraries now are grouped by same name too (all strikes together, defenses together, etc..)
[*] [CHANGE] Deck messages when you lose or add a card has double amount of time in screen in order to read it better.
[*] [CHANGE] Camera in map has been moved higher for a better view of the map cells.
[*] [CHANGE] Update card limit in combat is now of 10 either 20.

[*] [FIXED] Bug in tutorial you can not exit/resume if you open settings/options during tutorial combat.
[*] [FIXED] Discard Well went back to page 1 after remove any card.
[*] [FIXED] Draw cards loops made you can have more than 10 cards on hand. Max cards in hand are 10.
[*] [FIXED] IMMUNE info box of some enemies repeat same magic name.

[/list]

Best regards,

notes.title: Community Update 3 (July)
notes.content:
Hi Hunters!!
We have a new Update :)
This update has, basically, an[b] important change in the way to play Deck Hunter.[/b]
After receiving your valuable feedback about the fact that losing your cards after finishing the Forest is very frustrating, we've finally decided that now, [b]You are going to keep your deck after finish the Forest.[/b] This change will apply to future zones.

This change has the following consequences:
[olist]
[*] The progression between zones (Forest, Swamps,...) is lineal now. So, if you defeat Forest you automatically play Swamps. You can't choose the zone anymore.
[*] We increase (a little) the difficulty in the Swamps. You'll arrive at the Swamps with a powerful deck, so you need a good challenge :)
[*] Now the game has the same design as other roguelikes. It means you need to go forward winning combats until the end of the game. 
[*] If you die = You lose your cards and your progress on the map. You win your XP.
[*] Start a new game = You start a new adventure from the first level of the Forest with the default basic deck.
[*] Leave adventure = You lose your 30% of resources, XP, and map progression.
[*] Surrender option removed. You can only "Leave adventure" from the main menu.
[/olist]

[b]Also in this update:[/b]
[list]
[*] News System
[*] Bug fixing
[/list]

We hope this update improves your experience playing Deck Hunter!!


Friendly reminder that [b]you can support the game[/b] with:

[olist]
[*] A positive review.
[*] Recommended Deck Hunter to your friends.
[*] Sharing content of Deck Hunter on your social media.
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/mFYjqDg]Join our Discord[/url].
[*] Of course, buy and play Deck Hunter and come back to point 1.
[*] If you already have the game, buy it anyway and give it to someone important in your life :)
[*] And finally, if you did all of those points, spread the word of Deck Hunter!!!
[/olist]


Thanks!!

notes.title: The Major Update is here!!
notes.content:
Hi Hunters!
The Major Update is finally here!
I’m very happy to share this moment with you. It has been a long time since I decided to redo the enemy AI and, as a consequence, the most important parts of the game. It has not been easy to achieve this renewed version of Deck Hunter, but I committed with you, the community of Deck Hunter. Anyway, all the way through is past and, now it’s time to enjoy the game.

[previewyoutube=Mg3vVynLolc;full][/previewyoutube]

Talking about the Major Update, there are some important points that you must keep in mind:
[list]
[*] It is highly recommended to reset your profile once you update the game. It helps a lot to avoid save file issues. Of course, you’ll lose all your progress in the old version, but believe me, it’s worth it!
[*] The new enemy AI has created a new mechanics system. Every enemy is different and its behavior can change depending on its mates. A tip, face the combats as a “puzzle” that must be solved.
[*] The game continues on Early Acces, so I’m going to add new content with more frequency, this time.
[*] I have planned the following updates but, as usual, I would like to count on your feedback, proposals, and ideas. 
[*] Apart from your feedback, you can support the game with reviews (if you didn’t do it), recommending the game to your friends (now is 20% off) and following the Deck Hunter account on Twitter.
[/list]

Last but not least, here you have the most important points of this Major Update.
Thanks for your support!


[b]GENERAL[/b]
[list]
[*] Lots of UI/UX improvements.
[*] Art improvements.
[*] Completely redesigned enemy AI.

[*] Completly new Library Cards.

notes.title: COMMUNITY UPDATE v5.5 - HOW TO BE A GOOD ALCHEMIST!
notes.content:
Hi Deck Hunters! 

While I'm working hard on the next update, I'm reading your posts and comments on the Steam Community Hub, especially those related to Alchemy and Armors Durability. For this reason, I'm releasing today the Community Update v5.5.


As you know, the Alchemy is an important mechanic in the game. It's under development and I'm trying to get the best experience possible through Alchemy mechanic. I've developed new functions for it, so I hope they fit better in the game and you can enjoy it. 
And now, it's time for an alchemy lesson. Let me introduce you, The Alchemy Master (it's me with a mage voice).

[list]
[*] The Alchemy card is on your deck from the beginning.
[*] 
[*] You can use the Alchemy card at any time during your turn. This activates the Alchemy (the Alchemy icon is on).
[*] 
[*] If you try to use the Alchemy card and you don't have alchemical cards, a message appears explaining it. The Alchemy button will continue activated.
[*] 
[*] If you haven't used the Alchemy card at the end of the fight, it returns to your deck.
[/list]

Oh, look at him! It's the blacksmith! (it's me with a blacksmith mustache).
Thanks, the Alchemy Master... I'm the blacksmith and I'm here to talk about the armors durability. It has been modified and now the durability will be lost in two very specific cases:
[list]
[*] When you DIE.
[*] When you are a coward and surrender.
[/list]
The multiple suggestions of the villagers have made this little dwarf strive to reinforce his most valuable pieces.

On the other hand, I inform you that L_Draven is working hard to redo the entire enemies system. So, enjoy this new version and share your feedback on the forums. Remember, as good Hunters, we have to fight together to make a better game.

Sorry, I almost forgot something. L_Draven give me a note for you. Where are my glasses? These ones? 
Voice: “Welcome L_Draven, I'm EDITH”
¬¬
Maybe can work...
Me: Ok, EDITH, let me read the note with L_Draven voice.
EDITH: - do nothing -
¬¬

"Dear community, I've added new content (little) in this update:
Added 9 new cards, with the "CLONE" mechanic.
Added 3 rework cards (War Elefant, War Tortoise, and War Horse).
Some bug fixing.

Sincerely,

L_Draven (today, The Alchemist Master and the Blacksmith with Mustache)"

notes.title: COMMUNITY UPDATE 5.0 - The summer sale is over and Deck Hunter “mola”
notes.content:
Hi Hunters!!

I have not bought any game in the summer sale on Steam because I’ve been working on this new Community Update 5.0. There is no time to lose now!
If you have new games, good for you, but this new update has important features that require your immediate attention!!

Features:

[list]
[*] New combat HUD: New design with new functions. 
[*] New map HUD: New design. Forge added. It means you can change your outfit at any time from the map screen. As a consequence, Forge is not on the main menu screen.
[*] New armor pieces added.
[*] Armor pieces have durability now.
[*] New weapons with special actions added. Discover them all!
[*] Alchemy book:  Every new alchemy fusing action unlocked is registered in the Alchemy Book. You can check it during the run.
[*] New cards added.
[*] General balancing and bug fixing.
[/list]

I hope you enjoy this new update. As usual, I’ll appreciate any feedback from you. 
After this new update, it’s time to redone de enemies system. Thanks to your feedback I realized that the current enemies system needs some changes. I was thinking about it, and after some testing, I decided creating a new one is necessary. So, I’ll be focused on this feature (and bug fixing when is required) and there will be no updates for a while. 

At last but not least, I wanna share with you the following data of Deck Hunter. The average time played is 5 hours 9 minutes and 20% of the players have played more than 10 hours. Hunters, this is amazing, it means you are enjoying the game despite it’s an early access game developed by one guy. I’m pretty sure that we can build a great game together!! You can continue supporting the game with posting reviews (positive is always better) or spreading the word. Do your friends have Deck Hunter? Talk to them about the game! Do you know some streamer that plays card games? Request to him/her for a Deck Hunter streaming! Are you at a party? Just shout loudly “Deck Hunter” and have fun :P

Note: “mola” in Spanish means “something cool”.

notes.title: COMMUNITY UPDATE 3.0 - THE SPECIAL ONE
notes.content:
Hi Deck Hunters!!
The E3 is over and now is time to sharpen your sword and begin a new adventure with Avery!
I've read all your feedback and ideas to improve the game, and some of them are implemented in this new update. I'm so happy about the game reception and obviously is thank to you! Deck Hunters, you rock!!
I'm so proud of this new update, and I'm pretty sure that now the game experience is better than before. I hope you can enjoy the game with this new update and we can walk together in this early access, improving the game.
Of course, any feedback is welcome (in the feedback topic, please). Finally, if you want to support (more) this project, please post a review (if you don't do it yet).

UPDATE CONTENT:

Balancing cards searching a new grateful combat experience
For example:
[list]
[*] Strike = Deal 5
[*] Defender = Def 5
[/list]

New starting set cards:
[list]
[*] 6 Strike
[*] 6 Defender
[*] 1 Minor Healing instead Downgrade card
[/list]

I reviewed all upgraded cards to don't penalize the upgrading experience. Now evolved cards are better than the basic version. In order to that, the upgraded cost are now reviewed.

Rebalancing all enemy combat system to get the experience little less unfair. 
Reconceptualized all the enemy map system to have a better progression feeling during the game.

New final boss skills to offer a deeper combat experience.

New elements in the map.
[list]
[*] If you are in a started game: You must complete your current area to enjoy these new features.
[*] If you start a new game: You’ll enjoy the new map from the beginning.
[/list]

Discard well = You can remove 1 to 3 cards of your deck
Chest = Resources
Spin = Now outside of the Rest Area
Rest Area = Recovery life / Remove 1 card of your deck

Balancing the cost of the armors (resources) and the effects.

New system outfit generator for enemies only.
I’ve developed a new algorithm to create different combinations randomly for the enemies outfit. In this update, you can see this new feature in the Skeletons. The rest of the enemies will be available in future updates.


FIXED: Avery LVL-0 Issue.  (this fix is not a retroactive action. If you have Avery Lvl-0 in your current game, you must reset your profile)
FIXED: Magic effects didn’t work correctly.
FIXED: Improved the effects stack execution flow for a better experience.
FIXED: Ent Boss infobox works correctly now.
FIXED: Removed close button in Alchemy after forging the new card.
FIXED: Loot crashes.

ADDED: Now you can show/hide the legend in the map.

REVIEWED: Infobox & Cards effects. (English version only)
REVIEWED: Player level values.

Explanatory note: Some of you have commented about the name of the Bosses as a typo. Is not a mistake. As you can imagine, I don’t have the rights of this known names, so "these mistakes" is my special tribute.

Hi, Deck Hunters!!

The calendar shows May 1st and Deck Hunter is almost ready for launch. Only some fixes, polishing and tweaking needed. The first E.A version enters in the last phase before release. So, what's happening for not be ready at the end of April like roadmap said?

My April was a hell. It was very hard to try to polish and develop the game based on the huge amount of feedback received during the beta and the new content that was waiting to be added. I know that I'm working in an early access version, but my mind wrestled between release on time without some features or investing more time in developing to release a more complete early access version.
As you can see I finally decided more time for developing the game and I think it has been the correct choice. 
This extra time allows me to bring you a better experience in your first time you play the game. As a result of this extra time, let me show you some screenshots about what is waiting for you in the first early access (I worked in some art improvements also).

About the release date, as I said before, I'm currently working in balancing and small tweaks/bugs. According to my roadmap, the game will be ready in the second half of May.

I hope this new situation doesn't change your hype for Deck Hunter and we can enjoy all together this game and its development as a good card game community!

notes.title: IMPORTANT BETA UPDATE 0.0.3 AVAILABLE - READ FULLY
notes.content:
BETA UPDATE 0.0.3

Thanks for every comment you have about our cards balancing. Some of you advise me that there’s a problem with the last Powerful cards changes, but in the other way, there are positive comments about that decision. I prefer to prove it now it BETA version than make changes in Early Process. I would try another change balancing with those cards, my decision is to change the full concept of that card does. Some players abused of “farming” card system (that’s the key in the BETA process). In the way to correct those errors, I propose new balancing changes, in a few days I’ll send you a poll of which balance is better according to with your opinion. Oh! There are another IMPORTANT new for all of you, [b]FROM NOW ON  YOUR PROGRESS WILL BE KEEP BETWEEN UPDATES BUT IT’S SO IMPORTANT TO READ THE INSTRUCTIONS BELOW, IN ORDER TO KEEP YOUR CURRENT PROGRESS FROM UPDATE 002 INTO UPDATE 003 (THESE STEPS ARE NOT NECESSARY FOR FUTURE UPDATES):[/b]

[b]*** IMPORTANT NOTE TO SAVE YOUR CURRENT PROGRESS BEFORE UPDATE!!! ***
[/b]

BEFORE DOWNLOAD the update 003 of the BETA, you must follow the following instructions to keep your current progress and settings:

[list]
[*] Create a new folder named "saveData" into the game folder (usually in \Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Deck Hunter\) it must to be like this "\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Deck Hunter\saveData"

[*] Navigate into the following game folder (usually in \Program Files(x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Deck Hunter\DeckHunter_Data\StreamingAssets\Data\)

[*] Cut the following files (Ctrl + X) "dhSaveFile.dhf" and "dhSettings.dhf" 

[*] Paste the copied files (Ctrl + V) into the previously created folder "\saveData\"

[*] Now update the game into 003 version

[*] NOTE:  Don´t worry if the compilation info in the top of the screen shows version 002 because is taking it from your saveFile.dhf , it will be reset after reset profile or losing any combat.

[*] Enjoy! ;-)
[/list]


*** If you have any problem doing this, you can reset everything pressing the delete profile button (red button with a white cross in the right side of your profile name in Main Menu.


Here you can read the other changes in the update:

[list]
[*] ADDED: NEW SAVING SYSTEM. Now you will not lose your progress between updates.

[*] SET “Powered Strike” and “Powered Defender” with its original cost, (1) and ADD to both cards “Discard a random card from your card”

[*] ADD the keyword “FORGET” on “Sanation” card.

[*] CHANGE the name text of “Levep Up” card to the correct form “Level Up” ;)

[*] REDUCE the power of some combos (you may discover it).

[*] ADD some new secret combos (can you discover?)

[*] New balancing of Map: Area 2 would be more friendly...or not? ;)
[/list]

In the last UPDATE I tested an idea with the combo system, normally you can use it for obtaining benefits during the combat but now you need to pay attention because there are some “contra-combos” that works against you.

notes.title: BETA UPDATE 0.0.2 AVAILABLE
notes.content:
BETA UPDATE 0.0.2

Beta Changelog 0.0.2 (2019-03-02)

The first balancing of some cards breaks the flow experience. Some players advice me that now it’s hard to “farming” and that point is good, but now you don’t want to spend time upgrading cards because “FORGET” punishes the full combat experience. 

Cause that, I have decided to do a few changes on this update. Looking forward to your feedback.

[u][b]**IMPORTANT NOTE**[/b][/u]

[b]After update the version, if you can't continue your current run, its possible you MUST TO RESET YOUR PROFILE (you will lose your progress) pressing the red button now included at right side of your name and level info in main menu.[/b]
(sorry, I am working into a solution for this ASAP)

ADDED - Surrender button in combat.
ADDED - Delete profile button

FIXED - You could move the camera map with the instructions window opened.
FIXED - You could select a card just before the update effect appears.
FIXED - After defeat Ungolaint and leave the game, you could not continue.
FIXED - Redundant life information during combat hidden.
FIXED - You could select the end turn button before the update effect appears, and game crashed.
FIXED - Now, the leave adventure button reset your progress keeping your level.
FIXED - Now, if you complete the beta, you keep your current level to continue discover NEW CARDS and SECRETS.
FIXED - Now the rest areas can appear in different positions, not only in the left side of the map.


The next cards lose “PURGE” and get “FORGET” keyword:
Masterful Strike
Masterful Defender

The next cards lose “FORGET” and increase their costs by 2:
Powerful Strike
Powerful Defender

Vampire Kiss now DRAIN (7) life instead give you 7 energy.
Add one new secret combo.

Now Shebol applies “STUN” effect 3% less per combat.
Now Loxhoceles applies “POISON” effect 3% less per combat and gives “2” poison instead of “3”. 
Now Ungolaint (our favorite tinny spider) applies “POISON” effect 3% less per combat and gives “3” poison instead of “4”.

notes.title: BETA UPDATE 0.0.1 AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Hi DeckHunters!

I’m the first to be surprised by the welcome Deck Hunter Beta has had in the community, and I just can say “MANY THANKS TO ALL”. 
Your feedback is awesome and I really appreciate each of them. I'm currently working in bug fixing and some improvements. So, this is the first Beta Changelog.

Beta Changelog 0.0.1 (2019-02-28)
Fixed: When you pressed several times quickly the end turn button, it generated strange behavior in the enemies and drawing cards.
Fixed: When you dragged and released a card with the left and right mouse buttons pressed at the same time, the energy was reduced twice.
Fixed: When you opened Discard\Void\My Deck libraries and pressed on a card, it didn´t work.
Fixed: Now you can check the info of the card in the loot window before pick it.
Fixed: After defeated spider boss, the map in area 2 crashed showing cells with double icons and events.

Cards:
Now “Masterful Defender” card does “Cure 2” effect.
Now “Strike” and “Defender” cards are available in level 1 pick.
Now “Seeker” card is available in level 4 pick.
Now “Minor Healing” card is available in level 2 pick.
The next cards have now the FORGET keyword:
Powerful Strike
Powerful Defender
Seeker
The next cards have now the PURGE keyword:
Masterful Strike
Masterful Defender

Fixed “REDUCE” combo effects:
Now sets all cards in your hand to 0 until the end of your turn.
Now it’s re-assign on “Seeker Grimoire” Combo.

Change “ENERGY FLUX” combo. Now increase your energy by 2 this turn.
Increase Life Rank of Shebol and Lobrab.

The next cards now are available in Alchemy:

Strike
Defender
Thunderbolt
Level Up
Animal Ritual
Flame Souls

Some enemies have now the right category and type.
Add new awesome combos.


Remember, you can report your feedback through contact@ldraven.com.
I come back to my "devcave" for bug fixing ;)
Thanks!!
